articles.summary: Lotus Tech entered into an MOU with Finloop and FOMO Pay to explore cooperation in compliant tokenization, digital payment and innovative tokenomics models. The planned collaboration combines Lotus’ premium mobility strengths with Web3 fintech ecosystem to create new business value.
